recognize_zh: 低中倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑之間細胞密度高、脂肪減少，巨核細胞明顯增多並鬆散成群，大小不一、核深染不規則，周圍基質略呈流線狀，符合骨髓纖維化中巨核細胞群聚。
features: Hypercellular intertrabecular marrow with reduced fat
Markedly increased megakaryocytes forming loose and tight clusters
Megakaryocytes vary in size with hyperchromatic, irregular or bulbous nuclei
Background with pale eosinophilic, somewhat streaming stroma and dilated sinus spaces
Scattered erythroid and granulocytic cells; bony trabeculae at upper left, upper right and bottom
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) at low to medium power shows a hypercellular marrow with reduced fat between bony trabeculae. Megakaryocytes are markedly increased and form loose and tight clusters; they vary in size and have hyperchromatic, irregular and bulbous nuclei. The intervening stroma is pale and somewhat streaming, suggesting fibrosis, with dilated sinusoidal spaces. Findings are consistent with a myeloproliferative neoplasm with atypical megakaryocyte clustering, most suggestive of primary myelofibrosis; reticulin/trichrome grading and driver mutation studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: ET shows increased, mostly dispersed giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and normal cellularity without hyperchromatic atypia.
PV shows prominent erythroid and granulocytic panmyelosis with pleomorphic but non-hyperchromatic megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm or MDS with fibrosis
ddx.vs: MDS shows small dysplastic hypolobated megakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than large bulbous cloud-like forms.
Reactive hyperplasia shows increased but evenly spaced morphologically normal megakaryocytes without clustering or fibrosis.
